sentences.text: It depends on the sanctioned amount/limit: the documents do not state whether this MSE business loan is up to ₹50 lakh, and for a Tier 3 UCB the in-force directions say no pre-payment charges apply up to ₹50 lakh, while other cases fall under the approved policy of a UCB.
The bank’s sanction letters state pre-payment charges of 2% of the amount prepaid.
The documents do not state the sanctioned amount/limit, so they do not state whether the no-charge rule in paragraph 261(2)(ii) applies or whether paragraph 261(5) approved policy applies.

missing.searched: Whether this loan is up to ₹50 lakh
